For every model/task pair, selection reads the latest valid metrics_history record from each seed and chooses the highest finite per_env episodic_return_100. Ties prefer the larger current step, then the lower seed number.
Outputs are current-progress diagnostics only. Each video metadata records the selection history step/return and the actual checkpoint global_step used for its model state.
